DMart's small-town expansion signals retail demand shift

Avenue Supermarts, operator of DMart stores, is expanding its presence in smaller towns, indicating a shift in consumer demand towards value retail. This move suggests that smaller cities and towns are becoming a significant growth area for the retail sector in India. Analysts suggest that other value retail stocks may also benefit from this emerging trend.
